rootCause.failure: A translucent uniform source shows one-column alpha deficits around some internal tile boundaries.
rootCause.fix: Adaptive halo ceil(.5/min(deviceScale))+1 and matching interior<=512-2halo; invalidate owner geometry on halo change. For extreme scales where that interior cannot exist, sample only projected viewport into bounded device-sized RGBA blocks with alpha-aware bilinear filtering.
